The indentation of the subsequent line has also been modified to maintain consistent formatting.

### Relationships
- The modification in the `NEWS` file addresses a formatting issue that was introduced in a previous commit (identified as 970abef4c7). The patch corrects the alignment of the text to ensure that the list of changes is presented clearly and consistently, enhancing readability for users and administrators.
